$comment: The accessibility RATCHET, and the reason it exists.
axe was pointed at real pages for the first time on 2026-08-04. Counts are frozen per
(surface, state, project): a RISE fails, a fall is re-frozen (ADR-928).
STATE: 40 contexts, 156 serious+ elements, 15 clean. Down from 219 -- all of
that -63 was /pricing, whose value ledger rendered 21 `text-success` cells on the canvas
band at 4.05:1 instead of on white at 4.67:1.
WHY /spaces (44) AND /the-community (39) ARE NOW STALE, NOT ACCURATE:
ADR-929 gave accentize() a band argument and fixed all 32 call sites, which is the defect
these two numbers were measuring. They have NOT been re-captured against a deployment, so
they read high. A fall cannot fail CI, so this is stale-but-safe. Re-capture to correct it.
COVERAGE, and the correction that got the CAUSE wrong (2026-08-04):
An earlier header said '44 of 84 tests do not run without PW_STORAGE_STATE'. The 44 was
right and the cause was wrong. The real split was 27 mobile-project contrast skips that
are DELIBERATE (a11y.spec.ts:244 -- contrast is viewport-independent, so the desktop
project carries the render-state sweep), 12 genuinely blocked on the beta storage state,
and 5 for /circles.
The /circles five are now GONE rather than skipping: it sat in EDITABLE_PAGES (so the
registry offered it to anonymous visitors) and in proxy.ts PROTECTED_PATHS (so anon was
redirected to /sign-in). publicSurfaces() now filters the registry against the proxy's own
list, so a page that anon cannot reach is not an anon surface. That retired 5 a11y contexts
and 8 visual tests that could never have produced a number. Open /circles to visitors and
they come back automatically, with no edit to the test harness.
So the honest coverage line is now: 12 tests owner-gated on a seeded beta account, 27
deliberate, everything else measuring.
THIS NUMBER IS A FLOOR, NOT A CENSUS. axe returns INCOMPLETE rather than violation for any
element over a background-image, under a pseudo-element covering >25%, or at opacity 0. So
every ink band's contrast debt is unmeasured, as is everything below the fold in a Reveal.
Every number here is debt with a date on it. Lower them; never raise them.
Re-freeze with: PW_A11Y_UPDATE=1 pnpm test:e2e:a11y && pnpm a11y:baselines
2026-08-11 -- WHAT THESE NUMBERS NOW COUNT, AND THE NINE THAT WERE JUST SEEDED
A number here no longer counts every serious+ element axe finds. It counts every one
NOBODY HAS DECIDED ABOUT. Elements matching a named entry in test/e2e/a11y-waivers.ts
are subtracted first and printed as `a11y-waived` annotations instead. See ADR-982.
That change is why the marketing numbers below did NOT move even though run 31453092474
reported 15 marketing contexts over their baselines. Every one of those rises was the
owner's 2026-08-06 palette decision (white label on the brand amber) reaching axe for the
first time. Raising 15 counts to absorb one decision is exactly what ADR-980 forbids: the
raised number would also permit any unrelated serious violation up to it, forever. The
decision got named instead, and the counts stayed frozen.
THE NINE NEW KEYS ARE A FIRST FLOOR, NOT AN ABSORBED REGRESSION (FINALIZE 1.3).
/feed, /settings and /spaces/<slug>/manage had NO key at all until now, so they fell to
$defaultMax (0) and failed all nine of their checks the first time PW_SPACE_SLUG let them
be photographed. Establishing a floor for a surface that has never been measured is a
capture; re-freezing a surface that got worse is erasure. These are the first kind.
Per context, and what is actually in each number:
/feed [dawn-dark, contrast only, desktop]        0  measured 3, ALL three the amber. Clean.
/feed [dawn-light, desktop]                     12  CEILING, not a reading -- see below.
/feed [dawn-light, mobile]                       2  measured 6: 4 amber/success (waived) +
2 target-size, both now FIXED. Expect 0.
/settings [dawn-dark, contrast only, desktop]    0  measured 1, the amber. Clean.
/settings [dawn-light, desktop]                  7  CEILING, not a reading -- see below.
/settings [dawn-light, mobile]                   1  measured 1: the .sm:hidden search button,
now FIXED. Expect 0.
/spaces/danieltyack/manage [dawn-dark, ...]      0  measured 2, both the amber. Clean.
/spaces/danieltyack/manage [dawn-light, desktop] 8  CEILING, not a reading -- see below.
/spaces/danieltyack/manage [dawn-light, mobile]  1  measured 2: 1 amber (waived) + the same
.sm:hidden button, now FIXED. Expect 0.
THE THREE 'CEILING' ENTRIES ARE THE WEAKEST NUMBERS IN THIS FILE, deliberately and
temporarily. They are the raw measured totals, seeded WITHOUT subtracting waivers, because
the run log printed only the first 5 nodes of each violation and these three had 11, 7 and 8.
Every node that WAS visible on all three was an accepted palette pair, so the true post-waiver
residual is very likely 0-3, not 12/7/8. A ceiling was chosen over a guess: a guess that is
too low turns CI red for a reason nobody can reproduce. The node cap in a11y.spec.ts is now 40
rather than 5, so the NEXT run prints every element and reports the real number as an
`a11y-improved` annotation. Tighten these three the moment it does; until then they are the
widest holes in this gate.
NOT WAIVED, and staying failed on purpose: amber used as DISPLAY TEXT (`.text-primary`
headlines, 2.18-2.86:1 against a 3:1 bar), the `.text-text/10` watermark numerals in the dark
skins (1.3:1), and the tinted chips on /discover. The owner's decision covers a white label on
an amber FILL. It does not cover the amber as ink, and the waiver list is written so it
cannot be stretched to.
